mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate at or below 0.25% indicates an accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS <= 0.25%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 6.5% indicates a weak labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 6.5%, or the Rank IC over 2-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts (HOUST) above 1000 thousand units and retail sales (RSAFS) above 400,000 million dollars signal robust consumer demand, boosting corporate revenues and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST > 1000 and RSAFS > 400000, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a low inflation regime (CPIAUCSL < 238), a federal funds rate below 0.5% indicates sustained monetary accommodation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL < 238 and FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) above 138 million indicates a strong labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS > 138 million, or the Rank IC over 2-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 103.0 indicates a weakening manufacturing sector that reduces corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 103.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 0.25% and inflation (CPIAUCSL) above 238 indicate a tightening monetary policy cycle, reducing equity valuations and driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 0.25 and CPIAUCSL > 238, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a strong housing market regime (HOUST > 1000), rising retail sales (RSAFS) above 400,000 million dollars signal robust consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST > 1000 and RSAFS > 400000, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.
